brand_identity.tagline: It Started With Our Second Salary.
brand_identity.positioning: A premier venture-studio and company-building platform bringing together ambitious founders, strategic capital investors, deep technology execution (via EPOHTECH), and real market intelligence.
brand_identity.origin_story: Our founders gave their first salaries to their parents and God as a mark of gratitude. With their second salaries, they took the leap and built their first startup. Now, Second Salary Capital empowers the next generation of builders with capital, tech execution, and scaling ecosystems.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, modals, card actions MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='apply-founder-button', data-testid='investor-check-size-select', data-testid='nav-link-epohtech').
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: Ensure pure off-white #F4F5F7 text on #0B0C0E dark backgrounds exceeds 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Interactive buttons have explicit hover colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files throughout the codebase since the project uses JS React template.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll listeners for silky motion.
Do NOT use pure #000000; use #0B0C0E obsidian background with #13151A cards and #E6C280 champagne accent.
Ensure header nav has glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0C0E]/80 and explicit z-50.
Include full Google Sign-in simulation with toast notifications via Sonner.
Populate real content for all 13 support cards, 80+ investors metric, ₹10L–₹10Cr range, and EPOHTECH specs.
Add data-testid to every single button, link, form input, tab, card, and interactive component.
Support full routing for all 8 nav pages: Home, Build With Us, For Investors, What We Support, EPOHTECH, Our Story, Insights, Contact.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call AI slop. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
